##


**Who Are the Main Helluva Boss Characters?**


#


[Helluva Boss](https://wikipedia.org/wiki/Helluva_Boss) is an adult animated musical comedy created by Vivienne “VivziePop” Medrano and set in Hell. It follows I.M.P. ( *Immediate Murder Professionals* ), a small imp-run company that kills people on Earth for clients in Hell, using a spellbook borrowed from a royal demon named Stolas to travel between worlds. The series started on YouTube in 2020 and moved to Prime Video in 2025, and it shares its universe, the[Hellaverse](https://hazbinhotel.fandom.com/wiki/Hellaverse_Wiki) , with Hazbin Hotel.


There are more than 80 Helluva Boss characters, but the story centers on five: the four I.M.P. employees and Stolas.


###


**The I.M.P. Crew**


#


**Character** **Species and role** **Personality** **Backstory**


[Blitzø](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/blitz%C3%B8-ne6p2il07auf) (“the O is silent”) Imp, founder and boss of I.M.P. Loud, crude and reckless, hiding guilt and loneliness behind jokes Grew up performing in his father Cash Buckzo’s circus, until a fire he accidentally started killed his mother and injured his best friend Fizzarolli. His twin sister Barbie Wire still blames him.


[Moxxie](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/moxxie-3c3y0aenqg9p) Imp, weapons specialist and sniper Anxious, kind and musical; the team’s straight man Born into the crime family of his father Crimson, a Greed Ring mob boss. He met Blitzø in prison after a heist went wrong and joined I.M.P. when they escaped.


[Millie](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/millie-m1zmscxtoebl) Imp, close-combat fighter (axes and knives) Cheerful and outspoken, with a fierce temper when Moxxie is threatened Raised on the Haymurder family farm in the Wrath Ring with her sister Sallie May. Before I.M.P., she ran a two-woman assassin team with Cassity that ended in disaster.


[Loona](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/loona-k1t5sispyftz) Hellhound, I.M.P. receptionist Sarcastic, moody and protective under the attitude Adopted by Blitzø shortly before she turned 18. She is the only team member who can take on a human disguise.

##


**Helluva Boss Stolas: Personality, Powers, Lore and Relationships**


#


**[Stolas](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/stolas-n4caahngdx56)** is a demon prince of the Goetia family, a powerful line of hellborn royalty, and also one of the central and most popular characters in the show.


**Personality** : Stolas is a Goetic prince who looks regal, with a white heart-shaped face, two pairs of red eyes and a crowned top hat, but behaves like a dramatic, easily excited romantic. He is gentle with people he loves, lonely in his palace and often slow to notice how his choices affect others. Bryce Pinkham voices him in the series.


**Powers** : As demon royalty, Stolas is immortal unless struck by angelic weapons. He can grow into a giant feathered form, possess humans on Earth, move objects with his mind, turn targets to stone with a glare and open portals without his grimoire. In “Mastermind,” Satan stripped him of his power and status for a hundred years after he took the blame for Blitzø’s crimes, so he spends Season 3 without his old position.


**Lore** : Stolas is based on a Great Prince of the Ars Goetia in the Lesser Key of Solomon, an owl demon said to teach astronomy and the properties of herbs and precious stones. The show nods to this with his stargazing and his garden of Hell-flora. His father Paimon arranged his marriage to Stella and handed down the grimoire that I.M.P. now borrows.


**Relationships** : Stolas and Blitzø (Stolitz) met as children at the circus and later grew into real, messy feelings on both sides. Their complex relationship serves as a cornerstone of the series, evolving from a transactional arrangement for a magical grimoire into a tragic, slow-burning romantic conflict fueled by miscommunication across their social divide. His daughter Octavia comes first for him, and Season 3 finally gives them a reconciliation.


##


**The Seven Deadly Sins and Other Key Helluva Boss Characters**


#


The[Seven Deadly Sins](https://hazbinhotel.fandom.com/wiki/Seven_Deadly_Sins) rule the rings of Hell, and in Helluva Boss they act as bosses, judges and occasional allies of I.M.P.


- **Asmodeus** (Lust), known as[Ozzie](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/ozzie-n2rr0vzqscni) , runs a famous club in the Lust Ring and is openly in love with[Fizzarolli](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/fizzarolli-6lfju8keybx9) .
- **Mammon** (Greed) is a jester-like media mogul who made Fizzarolli famous and exploited him.
- **Beelzebub** (Gluttony), or Queen Bee, throws the wildest parties in Hell and dates Vortex.
- **Satan** (Wrath) created the imps as Hell’s workforce and presided over Blitzø’s trial.
- **Leviathan** (Envy) and **Belphegor** (Sloth) appeared briefly at the trial, while **[Lucifer](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/lucifer-w3p5farm13y1)** (Pride) rules Hell and stars in Hazbin Hotel.


Hell’s entertainers matter too. **Fizzarolli** , Blitzø’s childhood friend, became Mammon’s star performer after the circus fire, and **[Verosika Mayday](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/verosika-bs4oibxt490x)** is a succubus pop star and Blitzø’s bitter ex. **Striker** , a cowboy imp assassin who hates royals, ends Part 1 by recruiting Barbie Wire.


##


**Helluva Boss vs Hazbin Hotel: Same Hell, Different Story**


#


**Helluva Boss** and **Hazbin Hotel** are two shows in the Hellaverse, both created by Vivienne Medrano. Hazbin Hotel follows[Charlie Morningstar](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/charlie-n1jpbhbvancr) , Lucifer’s daughter, as she runs a hotel to redeem sinners, while Helluva Boss stays with Hell-born imps, royals and their relationships. Medrano has described Hazbin Hotel as a story about redemption and consequences, and Helluva Boss as one about characters who already live in Hell.


The two casts have barely met on screen so far. They share the **Seven Deadly Sins** , and Vassago first appeared in the Hazbin Hotel pilot. That changes in 2027: Medrano told Polygon in September 2026 that the crossover with Charlie and the Hazbin Hotel cast begins in earnest in Season 3 Part 2, with easter eggs hidden in Part 1.


Fans have been running their own crossovers between the two shows for years, in fan art, fanfic on AO3 or Wattpad and multiverse AUs that mix both casts. Until Part 2 arrives, you can stage your own version, such as pairing[Vox from Hazbin Hotel](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/vox-k8hsotlq8l0l) with Chaz from Helluva Boss, and watch them come alive in a roleplaying game you build.

If you want to spend time with Helluva Boss characters beyond watching the show, or build a Helluva Boss OC – with a full personality, backstory and relationships – who you can actually interact with, **Redbean** is built for that. It is a[free life sim-RPG sandbox](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/free-cozy-life-sim-with-your-own-characters) on iOS and Android where your characters become **playable** and **alive** in a pixel town you build.


###


🎨 **Character Creation**


#


- Turn any photo or your fan art into **a playable pixel character** , from an original imp OC to your version of Blitzø or Stolas. Edit details or change its appearance any time within a few words.
- Non-human designs work too, so hellhounds, owl princes and goat demons all render as main characters or NPCs.
- Give each character **their own personality, lore and speaking style** , so Blitzø stays crude and Stolas stays theatrical, they talk and interact as who you write them to be.


###


💬 **Roleplay**


#


- Play as your OC and **talk to any NPC in your town** about **your own plot** or about anything else.
- Characters remember what you tell them within the story you’re playing, and conversations shift how close or hostile they feel toward you. Relationships influence interactions and stories across your town.
- Set **any kind of connections** for your characters, from Stolas x Blitzø (Stolitz) slow-burn romance to Moxxie and Millie’s marriage to your OC’s rivalry with Cassity.
- **Write any scenario** and Redbean turns it into quests to play: for example, *your Helluva Boss OC could be the next target of the IMP crew* .

#


- Bring both casts into one town, from Stolas, Blitzø to Charlie, so I.M.P. and the Hazbin Hotel crew share the same streets.
- Place any two characters side by side so they can meet and interact, like Charlie pitching redemption to Blitzø.
- Write **any crossover scene** you want to see, such as Alastor crashing Stolas’s birthday or Vox and Chaz running a scheme together, and play it out as one of the cast.
- Style the town as Imp City, the Pride Ring or the Hazbin Hotel lobby from a few words, and even add your own music for a musical-show feel.
- The cast keeps living when you’re not there: characters follow their own routines, discover places and talk to each other without you.

**FAQ**


#


###


**Where can I watch Helluva Boss Season 3?**


#


Helluva Boss Season 3 streams on[Prime Video](https://www.primevideo.com/detail/0GEB35CUYRCDVXUV0UXQY9FHIF) , which also carries uncensored versions of Seasons 1 and 2 and the “Mission: Zero” pilot remake. Seasons 1 and 2 remain free on[VivziePop’s YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL-uopgYBi65HwiiDR9Y23lomAkGr9mm-S) , and new Season 3 episodes reach YouTube about 45 days after their Prime Video premiere. Note that the versions uploaded to YouTube will face slight censorship and audio edits.


###


**How many episodes are in Helluva Boss Season 3, and when is the next release?**


#


[Helluva Boss Season 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Helluva_Boss_episodes#Season_3_(2026)) has 15 episodes in two parts. Part 1 (7 episodes) was released on Prime Video in three batches: episodes 1 to 3 on October 14, 2026, episodes 4 and 5 on October 21 and episodes 6 and 7 on October 28. Part 2 (8 episodes) is set for 2027, and Season 4 will be the final season.


###


**Is there an official Helluva Boss game?**


#


There is no official Helluva Boss video game as of October 2026. The licensed Helluva Boss games are tabletop, such as the Kickstarter-funded card game “Immediate Murder Professionals.” Unofficial fan games exist on sites like itch.io, and many fans recreate the cast in sandbox games such as Redbean to play as them.


###


**Are Helluva Boss and Hazbin Hotel connected?**


#


Yes. The two shows share the same universe, the Hellaverse, along with characters like the Seven Deadly Sins, but each follows its own cast. You can watch them in either order. Creator Vivienne Medrano has said[the crossover between the two casts begins in Helluva Boss Season 3 Part 2 in 2027](https://www.polygon.com/vivziepop-interview-helluva-boss-hazbin-hotel-crossover/) .


###


**Who is Stolas in Helluva Boss, and is he still with Blitzø?**


#


Stolas is a Goetic owl prince of Hell, Octavia’s father and Blitzø’s on-and-off partner, voiced by Bryce Pinkham. At the end of Helluva Boss Season 3 Part 1, the two have made peace after “A Trial of Errors,” but Stolas is dating Vassago, and Blitzø wishes him happiness in “Yes / No.”
